thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging eng-oncall — KV pressure spike in cluster kv-prod-us-east-1. p99 streaming tail latency up to 3.2s, p95 ~0.9s. Eviction rate + prefill/decode imbalance trending upward. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/kv-pressure-4198765432
sam: I'm on pager, looking at traces now. grabbing top traces and tail logs.
marta: any visible customer errors? timeouts or 5xx?
sam: A few paid streaming sessions returned client-side timeouts (500ms+ retry windows) and a single partner reported degraded streaming. Error rate is small but latency SLO breach is showing in recent 10m windows.
priya: I see a sharp increase in small-slab fragmentation on node group s1-s2. Prefill workers spiking memory churn. decode threads are backloged — prefill is creating many small KV entries, then decoder has to materialize them causing stalls.
lee: Can you paste recent histogram? the shape at >512ms looks like decode tail.
sam: paste logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:14:22Z] shard=s1 event=evict candidate=kv/0x12f size=128
[2026-03-15T10:14:22Z] shard=s1 prefill_enqueue key=usr_... latency=5ms
[2026-03-15T10:14:22Z] shard=s1 decode_start key=usr_... queue_len=42
[2026-03-15T10:14:23Z] shard=s1 decode_finish key=usr_... duration=320ms
```
priya: that queue_len=42 is the giveaway. prefill is outrunning decode parallelism. Also eviction churn is increasing cache fragmentation which makes subsequent gets slow.
lee: quick mitigation ideas: (1) throttle prefill workers per shard, (2) bump decode worker pool for affected shards, (3) enable immediate compaction on high-frag shards, (4) route new streaming sessions to fallback model variant.
sam: Agreed. I'm going to throttled prefill for s1+s2 by 70% and spin up two extra decode pods in the zone. Applying now.
(sam edits cluster config)
deploy-bot: Starting rolling config change: prefill.throttle=0.3 for shards [s1,s2] (change id: cfg-419876-1)
sam: Done, throttle change applied. scaling decode pods +2 — pods c-kg-2/3 scheduled.
marta: Can we also temporarily raise eviction threshold to reduce fragmentation churn? Maybe increase slab_min_hold_ms from 50 -> 200.
priya: That's risky longer-term but ok as short mitigation. I'll patch slab_min_hold_ms=200 on s1 only.
priya: Patch applied: slab_min_hold_ms=200 (cfg-419876-2) — watching.
sam: p95 dropped from 0.9s to 0.55s in next 60s. p99 improved but still at 1.6s. streaming stalls count falling.
lee: Good. Next: set a background compaction job that runs with low priority and reduces fragmentation for s1. Use compaction throttle to avoid CPU spikes.
priya: Running compaction job now in low-priority mode:
```
POST /admin/kv/compact
{"shard":"s1","max_pause_ms":150,"priority":"low"}
```
priya: compaction started. initial estimate: 8min.
marta: Customer impact note: affected customers (acct-142, acct-220) had degraded streaming but no data loss. Alerting SRE/CS to proactively notify them?
sam: I'll message CS with the incident summary and mitigation steps. drafting now.
sam: CS note sent to #customer-notify: "We've applied temporary mitigations for KV cache pressure leading to streaming stalls. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and timeline." :white_check_mark:
lee: Plan for longer-term fix: (a) slow down prefill default rate and make auto-tuner shard-aware, (b) add decode backpressure signals so prefill stalls when decode queue > threshold, (c) improve slab allocator compaction heuristics.
priya: I'll open follow-up tickets and link perf traces. ticket: INF-2389: shard-aware prefill throttling + decode backpressure.
sam: For now, I'll stay on for handoff. Next oncall is marta at 11:00 UTC. If metrics remain stable for 30m, we'll de-escalate.
marta: I'll take handoff at 11:00 and continue monitoring metrics and compaction progress. thanks.
sam: handoff notes pasted: "throttle prefill 0.3 on s1/s2, slab_min_hold_ms=200 for s1, +2 decode pods, low-priority compaction running. p95 -> 0.55s, p99 -> 1.6s and trending down. watch grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/kv/kv-latency?vars=shard=s1"
marta: received. I will update the incident channel if p99 rises above 2.0s or eviction rate > threshold.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3 based on reduced customer impact and mitigations in place. Auto-check in 30m.
sam: Leaving notes in the runbook and assigning follow-ups: INF-2389 (prefill/decode), INF-2390 (slab compaction tuning), INF-2391 (customer postmortem for acct-142).
marta: Thanks team. I'll continue monitoring and do formal postmortem if metrics don't stabilize.
